hrApproval.confirmTitle: Lock this KPI set as the baseline?

hrApproval.confirmBody: There is no unapprove. Once the baseline is locked, the only way to change a KPI is a mid-year change request (§6.2).
hrApproval.approvedToast: The KPI set is approved and locked
hrApproval.lockedSubtitle: §5.1 — HR's approval is the lock, and there is no unapprove.

help.REQUIRED: A manager whose rating differs from the employee's self-assessment cannot save it without a written reason. This is more than §7.1 asks for — the spec puts the discussion offline — and it is a real burden on managers at year-end.
help.OPTIONAL: The reason field is offered and explained when the ratings differ, but a manager can save without it. Calibration reads whatever is written.

rounding.label: §8.7 — Round the final score to two decimals before choosing a band?
rounding.helpNo: Bands are read as continuous thresholds: 4.50 and above is Outstanding, 4.00 and above is Excellent, and so on. A score of 4.495 is Excellent, because it is not yet 4.50.
rounding.helpYes: The score rounds first, so 4.495 becomes 4.50 and is Outstanding. Same number, opposite band — and at that boundary it is the difference between a 2.0x and a 1.5x bonus coefficient (§11.3).
